text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to track progress and celebrate small wins along the way. Deliverables, such as reports or final products, show what the team must complete. Finally, stakeholder alignment is important because everyone involved should agree on the project's direction. When all stakeholders share the same understanding, the project is more likely to succeed.
